base.description: sha of the reviewed base commit

summary.description: 2-5 sentences on what the commit does, how risky it is, and whether it's ready or what blocks it. Written last, from the findings that survived.

handle.description: 1-3 kebab-case words to refer to the finding by

kind.description: code: the commit's code is wrong. split: the commit carries more than one purpose. reorder: the commit, or code in it, belongs somewhere else in the branch.

pre-existing.description: the defect is in code the base commit did not introduce

description.description: the defect and what it costs

location.description: path/file.ts:42 or some other description of location

evidence.description: how you checked, or what would settle it when the claim resists testing

fix.description: the recommended fix first, then alternative options

follow-up.description: whether the finding should be placed into a different commit than the base commit
